label: STATIC PRE-CHECK of the six-slot builder, run BEFORE any slot was implemented, as the directive requires. Determines which slots can change a decision in live2 at all.

S5_memory.verdict: UNEXPRESSIBLE AS SPECIFIED. Do not build or score its three alternatives.
evidence: live2 `desired_tier`: declared once at cstate.py:92 and WRITTEN twice at coordinator.py:423 and :425. There is NO READ anywhere in live2, so KEEP_GPU_WARM and OFFLOAD_TO_HOST cannot change any decision.
the `desired_tier` hits in policy/ are a DIFFERENT object on state.py:43 (HistoryBelief) read only by telemetry.py, which reports and does not decide.
`gpu_kv_tokens` is passed to ARMS through live2_configure and is NEVER enforced as a cap by the coordinator, so there is no KV pressure to manage.
there is no automatic eviction or demotion anywhere: the only eviction is an arm EVICT action.
EVICT (coordinator.py:418-421) only demotes the arm OWN session to cold and zeroes built_tokens, so it is self-harm with no contention to relieve.
S5_memory.consequence: lru, value-aware keep-warm and protect-active-robot-sessions all express retention under pressure. live2 has no pressure, no read of the retention field, and no automatic eviction, so all three are inert by construction rather than weak.

S3_reload_mode.verdict: UNEXERCISABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, not merely unobserved.
evidence: every write to a session belief in live2: cstate.py:181 and :201 set COLD, coordinator.py:420 (EVICT) sets COLD, coordinator.py:711 sets GPU on a completed build.
NO write ever sets belief to host, so believed_tier() is in {cold, gpu} and readiness() is in {COLD, GPU-WARM}.
HOST-WARM is therefore unreachable in CoordState, which is why no recall reached it across seeds 0 and 4; the earlier empirical note has a structural cause.
OFFLOAD_TO_HOST sets desired_tier, which is never read, and does not touch belief.
S3_reload_mode.consequence: S3 host-to-reload can never be selected. S3 reduces to warm-to-answer and cold-to-one-go-or-pieces, a 2 or 3 mode slot rather than 3 to 4.
S3_reload_mode.classification: UNEXERCISED, with a structural rather than statistical cause

slots_still_worth_building: S3 robot execution mode, minus the reload option

preregistered_expectations.S3_local_what_if: expected WEAK for the same reason, and further narrowed because the reload mode is unreachable.
preregistered_expectations.S5_value_aware: not screened at all, being unexpressible per above.
